notes.title: -50% discount on the 1st Anniversary of the Release
notes.notes:
Hello people!

May marked the first year since the release of We. The Refugees.

On this occasion, we have prepared a two-week long and the highest discount so far, reaching up to -50%!

During this period, we are also taking part in two events on Steam: One of them is Polish Constitution Days, and the other one... we will announce it soon :)

It's amazing that a year has passed since the release of our first game. During this time, we managed to sell 1,295 copies of the game, which translates into approximately 4 copies a day. It may not be a very large number, but we are extremely happy that we are still able to reach new players, and the reviews are mostly positive. We are pleased with the reception of the story in our game, and at the same time we have a lot of thoughts on what to do to make the next games better. We definitely want to invest more resources in expanding gameplay elements and mechanics known from RPG games to make our next game (which we are already working on!) a more interactive experience. Also expect more world exploration elements! There will still be time to announce the new title, and in the meantime we would like to thank our wonderful community for supporting us and being with us in our attempt to tell an ambitious story in games. Thanks to your involvement, we also manage to support charitable purposes in the form of NGOs with which we will continue cooperation.

Thanks again for all the kind words and take care!

notes.title: Hotfix number 1.224.1161 (11794003)
notes.notes:
Thanks to keen eye and persistence of an user on our Steam forums, it has been noticed that one of the hidden achievements was inaccessible during the playthrough.

The issue has been addressed, so feel free to race and be the first person to unlock it!

notes.title: Update number 1.223.1160 (11692752)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We continue to polish and update We. The Refugees. This time, the new patch includes:


 Fixed an issue with the "new act" screen sometimes not registering button presses
 Fixed an issue where main menu buttons would still register input while overlaid with "Credits" and "Memories" screens
 Fixed issue with the paragraph text sometimes not breaking properly in the Chinese language version
 Fixed an issue with the decision feedback icons not lining up properly with the text in the Chinese language version
 Several typographical errors fixed in Chinese and English versions

Thank you all for your continued interest in the project!

notes.title: Update number 1.211.1149 (11465778)
notes.notes: A minor update with spelling fixes to the Chinese version.

notes.title: Update number 1.208.1147 (11443522)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Yet another patch for We. The Refugees is live! This time we focus mostly on improved support of the Chinese localization, but outside of that an issue with Windows scaling has been fixed - display quality should no longer degrade when scaling above 100% is used.

notes.title: Chinese version of "We. The Refugees" available now!
notes.notes:
We finally got it! "We. The Refugees" has been successfully translated into Chinese! 

Thanks to the titanic work of our Chinese partner, we are giving you today a fully translated Chinese version of our game. We are very impressed with the skills of the translator, who was able to translate 300,000 words (that's about 2,000,000 characters!) of a highly nuanced script in just a few months. It was a really ambitious and incredibly energy-intensive challenge. But it worked!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714089/9f3e5ebab8ef0a0d6ed8fae3f06511b13d541a44.png

We are happy and proud to present you the Chinese translation of "We. The Refugees". The new language version should now be available for selection from the menu after downloading the latest game update.

notes.title: Update number 1.202.1141 (11353316)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A new patch for We. The Refugees is live! Most notably, we now offer you the Simplified Chinese language version, but we also fixed some issues with the skipping of cutscenes that has been found since the release.

notes.title: Update number 1.192.1132 (11286247)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We continue to polish and update We. The Refugees. This time the new patch includes:


 Fixing a text scrolling issue that appeared when game was set to the biggest font size
 Fixing an issue with the date display in one of the chapters
 More fixed typos as usual
 Fixed a map issue when strolling around with Isaac in chapter 2
 Fixed a map issue when looking for accomodation also in chapter 2

notes.title: Update number 1.185.1112 (11201263)
notes.notes: Hi everyone! We have uploaded yet another patch, fixing some minor issues with the English translation as well as getting rid of typos in both Polish and English.

notes.title: Hotfix 175.1095 (11138968)
notes.notes: Thanks to the help of a keen-eyed player, an issue with one of the narration paths has been identified and fixed. Thank you!

notes.title: Update number 1.173.1092 (11131624)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that the first patch for the game has been uploaded on Steam! Update number 1.173.1092 (11131624) includes some minor spelling fixes that we didn't catch before the release, and also addresses a missing dialogue option.

We hope that these changes will enhance your overall gameplay experience and make your time spent in our game even more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support, we can't wait to see what you think of the game once you finish it!

notes.title: EGX London 2022 & QR codes for the pre-release version of our demo! / DEVLOG#8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We would just like you to know that we will be attending EGX London (22nd-25th September), albeit as visitors. It will be a great opportunity to meet a lot of you and have a good time at the event. 

We have a small surprise waiting for you all: During the EGX, we will be giving away special cards with QR codes that will allow you to download our demo a few days before its official premiere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714089/f459dc4cd63911954b4c06ba7fc9510aec9251e4.png

So, if you are attending the EGX, don't shy away from saying "Hi" to us. Or feel free to write a comment and we'll do the rest 🙂

See you there 🙂
Team Act Zero
